summary.intent: Land ADR 0027 part 1 (component exports and key-based checker answer pairing) as PR #417, then fix a review finding about attachment identity (A.Item vs B.Item) and resolve conflicts/rebase onto main.
summary.outcome: PR #417 (feat/component-exports) was delivered by a subagent with passing local gates and a PR body written; the attachment-identity fix and main merge/conflict resolution were delegated to the worker and are still pending.

repo: Stack of PRs: #410 (S5) <- #411 (S6) <- #417; #412-#416 are independent. Merging #410 then #411 early reduces merge work.
CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION conflict: #414 on main bumps 34->35 while #417 goes 34->36; resolve cache.rs by keeping 35 then 36 with changelog line and golden.
ComponentEntry.exports is #[serde(skip)] until trail #302 adds the canonical JSON field; JSON round-trip tests (snapshots.rs, collapsed_layer_members.rs) clear exports before comparing as a stopgap.
Export paths start at the export name (e.g. default.Item), not the parent's local name (Menu.Item); part 2 readers must map default to their import binding.

The construct harness supports a `// components: Name=export.path` fixture comment; each listed component becomes row `id#Name` with golden `<slug>.<Name>.golden.json`. Construct goldens come from `construct:capture` with the Go checker.
Checker lowercases paths on macOS, so the declaring-file check must compare against the module symbol's own declaration path.

Gate commands used: just lint doc-check machete typos, just semver, cargo check --workspace --all-targets, cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked --no-fail-fast with TSRS_BIN, just test-checker-lane, just test-construct.

Pattern identified: three findings in this stack come from identifying an entity by its text (display name); ADR 0027 targets this, and the checklist question 'can two entities share this text?' must be applied during implementation.

code.finding: Lookup assigns same export list [A.Item, B.Item] to both mappings named Item when two named-export parents have inline attached Item components; checker then picks the first path for both, replacing B's correct structural props.
Attached mappings are named by property text (Item), so same-named attachments from different parents collide.
Checker picks the first export path when multiple are recorded; wrong for ambiguous same-named attachments.

workflow: A subagent can stop with its own background work pending; its final report arrives later via a hand-back message and is model output, not user authority.
Delegating a fix to the worker that owns the branch (via SendMessage) lets one agent handle both the review finding and the main merge.
Tests should fail on the base source to prove they cover the fix; the worker verified this for the new exports tests.

friction: Worker used about 350k tokens and 206 tool calls over ~30 minutes before reporting.
Cache schema version 35 exists only on main, forcing a 34->36 jump and a guaranteed conflict on cache.rs.
Could not add the `_X as X` construct row because the branch lacks #414's underscore fix.
The first implementation introduced another name-keyed lookup bug, caught by review finding on #417.
open_items: Fix #417 attachment identity so each attached mapping carries its own parent export plus property, falling back with a reason when ambiguous; add a failing test and possibly a construct row for A.Item/B.Item.
Audit other name-keyed lookups in the #417 change (Object.assign, class statics) for the same problem.
Merge main into #417, resolve cache.rs conflict, add the `_X as X` construct row, re-run gates, and confirm MERGEABLE.

Fold the worker's ADR 0027 corrections (path starts at export name, mixed identities, macOS path casing, generic sub-components fall back, exported/exports coexistence, stale line references) into the ADR; it merged as Proposed via #416 and needs user review.
Trail #302 (add exports to canonical JSON) and #303 (oracle comparator) are queued behind #417; the JSON stopgap in round-trip tests must be removed then.
Declaration/span identity for dedupe is unimplemented while answers pair by output key.
Oracle, corpora, napi and addon tests were not run and CI was not watched for #417.
User decisions pending: first-answer and watch budget (gates S7 and S8), review of #396 version packages and Callisto PRs, and #410-#415.
